Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the team

GenAI Engineering sits within Motorway's Data and AI function, alongside Machine Learning and the Machine Learning Data Platform. We own the AI features that shape how buyers and sellers experience the marketplace, from agentic workflows in the customer journey to LLM-powered tooling for our dealer network.

What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to build AI applications and agentic workflows for Motorway, taking them from rapid prototype through to production-grade systems that deliver measurable value.

You'll take a problem that isn't fully defined yet and see it through to a reliable system running in production: the prompting, the retrieval, the agent design, the evals, the guardrails, the monitoring. You own that whole stack. There's no separate team who "productionises" your work later.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. If that's the work you want to do, we're not precious about the route you took to get here. Some of us came through data science and machine learning and deliberately built up our software engineering; others came the other way.

In this role, you will:

  • Own AI features end to end, from an ambiguous problem through to a reliable, observable system that real customers depend on.

  • Build the retrieval and data foundations these features stand on, and treat retrieval quality as a first-class engineering problem rather than a tuning exercise.

  • Design evaluation and monitoring approaches that make quality, reliability and safety measurable rather than assumed.

  • Build AI applications and agents using LLMs, orchestration, APIs and data systems, applying solid production software practices throughout.

  • Make the calls on models, cost and latency that shape what a feature costs us to run, and document the reasoning so others can follow it.

  • Prototype quickly, work out what is reusable, and harden the patterns that work into components the rest of the team adopts.

  • Raise the quality of the work around you through code review, design feedback and the standards you set by example.

  • Represent your technical decisions directly to product managers and stakeholders, translating model behaviour into business consequence.

About you

  • You've shipped AI or ML systems that real users depend on, and you've stayed close enough to production to know how they behave when they break.

  • Strong Python, and SQL you genuinely use. A lot of this work is data work: assembling grounding data, building golden datasets, and digging into why something failed.

  • You've invested deliberately in your software engineering craft: testing, error handling, CI/CD, observability, and the MLOps practices that keep things healthy once they're live.

  • You're hands-on across the GenAI stack: LLM APIs, retrieval and vector stores, agents with tool use, and structured outputs, running on cloud infrastructure (we use AWS and GCP).

  • You have a real point of view on evaluation, most likely because you've been caught out by a system that looked fine and wasn't.

  • You can reason about how models fail, including hallucination and prompt injection, and what that means for someone who trusts the output.

  • You know when to reach for a model, when something simpler will do, and when to stop.

  • You're a constructive reviewer, and colleagues are better off for having worked alongside you.

You could be a great fit if

  • You're curious about how things actually work, and you follow that curiosity past the first plausible answer.

  • You're drawn to problems where the right approach isn't obvious yet.

  • You're honest about the limits of what you know and pull people in early rather than late.

  • You take responsibility for what you ship, watch how it behaves, and fix it when it breaks.

  • You get satisfaction from the unglamorous work that makes an AI feature actually good, not just the part that demos well.

  • You can disagree well, and commit once a decision is made.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best.   • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

We’re looking for a Product manager to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our firm management problem space. You’ll take responsibility for how firms onboard with Seccl, manage their businesses and deal with performing compliance checks on end investors.

You’ll work as part of a cross-functional team, collaborating and partnering closely with engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, and our risk and compliance team to drive meaningful outcomes for our clients and their end users.

Working alongside the product leadership, you’ll define the long-term vision for your product, establish metrics, and use that to frame progress. Your role involves deeply understanding market dynamics, identifying pain points and opportunities, and translating these insights into demonstrable customer value.

With your Senior engineering manager, you’ll lead your squad through discovery, shaping, development, and delivery. Balancing strategic thinking with execution to shape the future of our platform. You’ll work closely with our customer and operation teams to gather insights and requirements, validate solutions, and problem solve while using quantitative and qualitative data to make evidence-based decisions.

You’ll work at the heart of your squad, prioritising and maintaining a consistent view across your team of what you should be building and why. You’ll balance competing priorities and technical initiatives against your own strategic view, aligning the resultant roadmap with risk and compliance to ensure a balance of product improvement, innovation and regulatory integrity.

You’ll be responsible for building with your squad, developing a broader strategic direction and coordinating with Product leadership in a domain that’s centred around how Seccl’s customers set-up and operate. You’ll parse information in your domain and develop that into a roadmap with associated discovery and shaping.

These are some of the main problem spaces that you’ll be working on:

  • Firm onboarding, set-up and branding: Ensuring that firms can start making the most of Seccl’s products. That starts early in the launch process and carries through to how companies with billions of pounds under management can run their businesses on our platform effectively.

  • KYC, AML and sanction screening: Working closely with our Risk team and customers to deliver products and workflows that keep all parties compliant and assured. As a regulated entity and organisation that cares about the longevity of our business, this is foundational.

  • Operational Products: Solving problems for ops users as they manage how end investors interact with our processes. Ensuring that Seccl can continue to scale smoothly.

  • You partner effectively with engineering, operations, customers and risk or compliance stakeholders

  • You’re comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of a scaling business

  • You have experience in fintech, particularly in an early-stage or scaling business, and with regulated products.

  • Desired: You have a passion and track record in improving end user experience while maintaining flawless fraud-management regulatory compliance

Who you are...

  • A builder: The thing that you want to do is build what our customers, both existing and future, want to use. All the things that you do and how you approach the day-to-day are orientated around this.

  • Curious and empathetic: The best way to build things that people want to use is to understand the nature of the problems that afflict them. You’re someone who is both fascinated by those problems and can gather the data that defines and clarifies them.

  • Able to handle scaling: Seccl is growing quickly and that means there’s a lot of context to understand and a growing world of possibilities to explore. You’re able to articulate what assumptions you’re making and guide people through your reasoning.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a lead product marketing manager to join our marketing team.

You’ll be the product expert within marketing – someone who gets properly under the skin of what we’re building, why we’re building it and the value it creates for our customers.

Working closely with our product, sales and customer-facing teams, you’ll turn that understanding into clearer propositions, stronger product adoption and more compelling ways of explaining Seccl’s value to existing customers and future prospects.

We’re looking for someone senior enough to shape product marketing at Seccl, but who also enjoys getting into the detail – understanding how things work, asking difficult questions and turning complex capabilities into clear, useful outputs.

What you’ll be doing

  • Getting under the skin of Seccl’s products – working closely with product teams to understand what we’re building, why it matters, how it works and where it creates value for customers

  • Working closely with product teams throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and development through to launch and adoption

  • Building trusted relationships across product, sales, customer and marketing, and establishing practical ways of working

  • Helping existing customer firms understand and use more of the platform, supporting feature adoption and customer growth

  • Using buyer, customer, competitor, CRM and win/loss insight to sharpen Seccl’s positioning and messaging

  • Helping commercial teams explain Seccl’s value through clearer propositions, sales materials, objection handling and support for priority deals

  • Building better feedback loops between customers, commercial teams and product, turning insight into recommendations that inform product and commercial decisions

  • Supporting and developing others through clear direction, useful feedback and high standards

This role’s for you if...

  • You have strong product marketing, proposition or go-to-market experience in a product-led B2B technology, fintech, SaaS or similarly complex environment

  • You’re genuinely fascinated by technology and how products work. You enjoy getting into technical detail, asking questions and working out how to explain complex capabilities in ways that make sense to different audiences

  • You have a strong commercial instinct and understand how product marketing can support both new business and existing customer growth

  • You enjoy getting stuck into the work yourself, while also being able to think strategically and set direction

  • You’re confident working with customer, market and CRM data to identify trends and turn insight into useful recommendations

  • You’re comfortable working in ambiguity, bringing structure and rigour without unnecessary process

  • You’re curious about how AI is changing product marketing, from sales enablement and internal knowledge sharing to how buyers research and discover suppliers

This role isn’t for you if…

  • You only work at strategy level. We’re looking for someone who also enjoys getting into the detail and producing practical, useful work, as well as setting direction

  • You need everything clearly defined from day one. There’s plenty of opportunity to shape how product marketing works at Seccl, so you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and building things as you go

  • You value process over progress. We need structure and rigour, but also someone who can make decisions and keep things moving when the answers aren’t clear-cut

  • You prefer to work independently of other teams. This is a highly collaborative role, and your success will depend on building trust and strong working relationships across the business

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 A salary between £80,000 and £95,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

Our culture

title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

In this role, you'll...

    • Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users.
    • Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.
    • Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.
    • Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all.
    • Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirement

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost.
  • AI-fluent: you've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you
    • Speak at least conversational French
    • Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear.
    • Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance)
    • Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.
  • Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here.

If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

 

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
About Sidetrade

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

The role

As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.

You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
  • Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
  • Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
  • Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
  • Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
  • Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
  • Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
  • Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
  • Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.

title: Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 (Master ou diplôme d’ingénieur) en photonique, optique, électronique, mécanique, physique appliquée, physique de la matière condensée ou dans un domaine connexe. Un doctorat (PhD) serait apprécié.
  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail
      • Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux

Processus de recrutement :

Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste.

title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One

Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

Tu es ingénieur.e de formation ou équivalent, et tu disposes d’une expérience réussie (environ 10 ans) dans la gestion de projets techniques, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé ou dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

title: Consultant Senior - Transformation, Marketing & Expérience Client (F/H)
Head of Strategy & Insights
AI Engineer - Full time
description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

  • Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

  • Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

  • Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.

  • Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.

Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.

  • Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.

  • Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).

  • Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.

What We're Looking For

  • 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

  • Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

  • Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).

  • Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).

  • Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

  • Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis.

  • Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.

  • GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

  • Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

  • NLP background

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

  • Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: AI Researcher - Full time
description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Researcher to push the frontier of floorplan generation. Working directly with architects, you'll own research directions end-to-end, from diffusion and flow matching models (continuous and discrete) to deployment in a product used by real estate professionals.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Our Mission

We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. By leveraging discrete diffusion models (operating on structured representations rather than pixels), we aim to produce floorplans and site plans that respect real-world constraints (zoning laws, space requirements, etc.) and can be iteratively refined like a human-designed plan.

The Role

We are looking for a AI Researcher to lead this effort in our Paris office. If you’re excited about improving our current state-of-the-art floorplan generative model and applying it to a high-impact domain, this role offers a unique opportunity to define a new class of AI-driven design tools. You will work within a focused team of 3–4 engineers and researchers, collaborating daily with architects to turn foundational research into deployable tools.

What you'll own:

  • Model Architecture & Design Space: Design the core model architecture and work on a discrete design space for architectural layouts. You will choose how to represent floorplans (e.g. as graphs of rooms/connections or token grids) such that the diffusion model’s outputs are editable and code-compliant by construction. This involves ensuring the model can enforce architectural rules (e.g. room sizes, adjacency constraints) within its generation process.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Lead the training of a foundation diffusion model from scratch on GPU clusters. You’ll set up distributed training across multiple nodes, optimize data loading and checkpointing, and manage experiments at scale. The role requires hands-on engineering for efficient training of large models on high-performance computing infrastructure.

  • Benchmarking & Iteration: Evaluate the model’s performance and establish benchmarks to measure success. Using these evaluations, you’ll iterate on the model to push performance beyond existing methods. Our goal is to surpass the latest research results and produce genuinely useful architectural designs.

What We’re Looking For

  • Applied Research Excellence: PhD or Master’s in Maths, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong foundations in ML and a track record of innovative research, publications, or high-impact projects.

  • Diffusion Model Expertise: Deep understanding of diffusion models (discrete or continuous), guided generation techniques, and the latest advances in generative modeling.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Proven experience training large-scale deep learning models on GPU clusters. Comfortable with distributed training, multi-node jobs, experiment management, and handling large datasets.

  • Technical Engineering Skills: Proficiency in Python with experience in PyTorch or similar frameworks. Ability to write efficient, maintainable code and optimize training pipelines. Familiarity with distributed training libraries (e.g., PyTorch Lightning) is a plus.

  • Research Literacy: Ability to read, evaluate, and implement advanced ML research. You stay current with state-of-the-art generative modeling work and can adapt cutting-edge methods to domain-specific problems.

  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong teamwork skills. Able to articulate complex concepts clearly and work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and domain experts to integrate technical solutions into the architectural design workflow.

Nice to Have

  • Industry Experience: Background in a top AI research organization or cutting-edge startup, especially working on foundation models or generative AI tools.

  • Publications/Open Source: Research publications in generative modeling (diffusion, VAEs, flows, GANs) or significant open-source contributions demonstrating ability to push state-of-the-art systems.

  • Domain Knowledge: While not required, an interest in architecture or design will help.

  • Reinforcement Learning & Optimization: Experience with RL, reward modeling, or constrained optimization (particularly MCTS, GRPO and RLHF) relevant to guiding generative models under complex constraints.

  • Multimodal Generation: Experience with graph-based, sequence-based, or discrete structured generative models (e.g., molecule generation, layout generation, program synthesis) or with graph neural networks.

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 12 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Build what no one has before: the foundation model that automates architectural design and redefines how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • Work on meaningful challenges: from constraint-aware generative models to real-world deployment in major construction projects.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • Ship fast, iterate boldly: go from research to prototype to production in weeks, not years.

  • Join a world-class team: a mix of AI researchers, engineers, and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

title: Psychologue | Operations & Community Manager (FR)
description:
Starting position designed to grow fast in a Mental Health Startup | Psychology background | French & English must | Join a mission driven Team | Passion needed | 100% | Office in the heart of Zurich with potential day trips to Romandie, remote only not possible

Why we do what we do

We see the world through the lens of our psyche — like looking through a window that casts the outside world in shades of gray or vibrant colors. Every day, each of us has the power to shift our perspective and experience reality in a new way. When people gain access to this insight, mental barriers transform into opportunities for personal growth, leading to a more fulfilling and happy life. And because happiness is contagious, society changes—one mind at a time.

You studied psychology. Now what?

You love psychology. You've spent years learning how people think, feel and change. But you don't see yourself in a therapy room every day, and the other doors everyone points you to don't feel quite right either.

There is another one. At Aepsy, you'll work with psychologists instead of patients: finding them, supporting them, growing a community together and helping them build a practice they love. Your psychology background isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the reason psychologists will trust you.

The role

As Community Manager Romandie, you own our community of French-speaking psychologists in Switzerland, as part of our Community & Operations team in Zurich alongside the leads for our German-, Italian- and English-speaking communities. You find and onboard psychologists, you are their first point of contact, help them with administrative and everyday questions, and look out for new opportunities so they can bloom. Together, we will shape the role around your strengths and passions. This is a starting position designed to grow fast, with real ownership from your first weeks.

Be their voice inside Aepsy

  • Bring psychologists' feedback into our product, processes and operations

  • Work closely with our marketing, product & design, sales and insurance partnerships teams

  • Help with client support, translations and content in French

  • Spot what's not working yet and come up with better ways to do it

Key things we are looking for

  • You enjoy reaching out to people, finding out authentically what the right path is for them. When something gets in their way, you don't just take it away, you want to make it better. This role needs both: the courage to reach out and the heart to take care.

  • You're structured and at the same time full of ideas you want to push for. You're proactive, see opportunities in challenges, and thrive in a team where everyone supports each other and grows for something bigger.

  • If you hear about Aepsy's mission, your heart should beat faster, and your hand should instinctively reach out — because you won't want to miss the opportunity to be part of it. We need people who are crazy enough to believe that their actions can change the world.

In a nutshell

  • Full-time position (100%) on-site in Zurich, with potential day trips to Romandie

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology

  • Work experience or projects that demonstrates your dedication (customer-facing, sales, student association…)

  • Structured, proactive and independent, and a natural relationship builder

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in French (spoken & written)

  • Good English (spoken & written) to work and communicate with our team every day

Together with us

We are a vibrant team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs, and we genuinely love what we do. We love conversations about the big picture as much as the smallest details. We work hard to make the world a slightly better place.

At the same time, we are mothers, fathers, husbands and wives, wine lovers, stand-up comedians, musicians, dancers, yoga practitioners, and Zen monks who appreciate and enjoy life.

Ready to join?

Sleep on it, take another look at this job ad. Read it again, believe that you belong at Aepsy, take a deep breath, and send us a personal application letter. (Yes, we will read it carefully, so please don’t send us generic templates, ChatGPT building blocks, or anything similar—there are so many better things to do.) Include your resume, and we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

  • Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

  • Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

  • Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

  • Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

  • Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

  • Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

  • Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

  • Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.
